//: Copy to appsettings.Development.json and fill in. That file is gitignored, used directly by `dotnet run`, and mounted into the container by docker-compose.yml - one file serves both, so a token minted by one is accepted by the other.

ConnectionStrings.//: Host values here are the `dotnet run` ones. Compose overrides this to Host=db because inside a container localhost is the container.

Jwt.//: Generate with: openssl rand -base64 48. Must be at least 32 bytes or the API refuses to start. Nothing overrides this - it is the one real secret and it never leaves this file.

Smtp.//: Reads reset codes and already-registered notices from the mailpit service (inbox at http://localhost:8025). Compose overrides Host to `mailpit`. UseStartTls must be false for any local catcher - none of them offer TLS - but leave it true in deployed environments.

RateLimiting.//: Mirrors the defaults in Program.cs. Spelled out because the auth limit is low enough to trip while probing login/register by hand - raise it locally rather than wondering why everything returns 429.
